description: Election Commission - O. K. D. Susantha was selected as the member of the  Karandeniya P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Karandeniya Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local government, including the resignation of a member and the nomination of a replacement by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
